day_shape: 53 items: CENTCOM says 70+ tankers blocked from Iranian ports holding 166M barrels/$13bn, Iran condemns overnight US strikes on tankers near Jask and Strait of Hormuz, regime stages Larijani commemoration, Hezbollah drones wound three IDF soldiers.

threads.label: US strikes on Iranian tankers and Hormuz coast
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned overnight US strikes on two Iranian oil tankers near Jask and points along the Strait of Hormuz, calling them ceasefire violations, while Araghchi warned of 'thousand per cent' readiness to defend. Defa Press reported explosions heard in Sirik and the Navy's seizure of a tanker named Ocean Koi.

threads.label: CENTCOM tanker blockade and Hormuz pressure
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces are preventing more than 70 tankers from entering or leaving Iranian ports, holding over 166 million barrels of oil worth an estimated $13 billion-plus. Jerusalem Post reported UAE interceptions of missiles and drones from Iran and Rubio warning on Iranian control of the Strait, while Khamenei said Iran will secure the Persian Gulf.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone strikes on IDF in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported two IDF soldiers moderately wounded and one severely wounded in two separate Hezbollah explosive-drone incidents, confirmed by the IDF. Defa Press and IRIB claimed Hezbollah suicide drones hit an Israeli vehicle and soldiers in the Deir Seryan area.

threads.label: Larijani commemoration and war-damage messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried extensive coverage of a Tehran commemoration ceremony for 'Martyr' Ali Larijani and his son at Imam Sadiq Mosque, with statements from Bagheri and Hojjat al-Islam Ansari. President Pezeshkian visited damaged sections of the Saadabad complex, while Cultural Heritage Minister Salehi Amiri claimed 149 historical artefacts were damaged with initial damage estimated at $7.5 million.

threads.label: Iran nuclear sites and human-rights concerns
threads.summary: Iran International cited an Institute for Science and International Security satellite-imagery analysis finding at least six Iranian nuclear sites hit in recent US and Israeli strikes, most tied to weapons-relevant work. Other Iran International and Times of Israel items flagged the imminent execution of an aerospace graduate student and rising arrests, torture and execution fears in the Baha'i community.

events.title: Top Iranian graduate student faces imminent execution, activists warn
events.summary: Iranian activists are warning that a top aerospace graduate student sentenced to death on espionage charges may face imminent execution after being transferred from Tehran’s Evin prison to Ghezel Hesar prison, a facility associated with executions.

events.title_en: Trump's second legal defeat
events.summary_en: Trump's second legal defeat. A federal trade court in the United States declared Trump's executive order to impose a 10 per cent customs tariff on all imports to the country unlawful and unauthorised. The court, by a two-to-one ruling of its judges, stressed that the President had circumvented the law with this order. This is Trump's second legal defeat in his tariff campaign. Previously, the US Supreme Court had rejected Trump's attempt to impose significantly higher tariffs. The White House has not yet reacted to this ruling.

events.summary_en: Statement by Foreign Ministry on ceasefire violation by America. events.summary_en: Araghchi's warning against new American adventurism. events.title: US and Israeli strikes hit Iran sites tied to nuclear weapon work, think tank says

events.title_en: Haaretz: Israel has authorised limited Red Crescent access to Palestinian prisoners detention facility
events.summary_en: Haaretz: Israel has authorised limited Red Crescent access to Palestinian prisoners detention facility. Following increased human rights pressure and international criticism of the condition of Palestinian prisoners, the Zionist regime announced for the first time since the beginning of the Gaza war that it would grant the International Committee of the Red Cross access to visit prisons where these prisoners are held; although it continues to prevent representatives of this body from meeting the prisoners themselves. This development comes as human rights organisations and international bodies have repeatedly, since the beginning of the Gaza war, expressed concern about the conditions of detention of Palestinian prisoners, restrictions on access to monitoring bodies and reports of mistreatment of detainees...

events.title_en: Seizure of offending tanker Ocean Koi by Navy
events.summary_en: Seizure of offending tanker Ocean Koi by Navy. Divers of the Islamic Republic of Iran's Army Navy, in a special operation, seized the offending tanker Ocean Koi, which was attempting to disrupt Iran's oil exports and the interests of the Iranian nation, and returned it to the country. In this operation, Navy divers and riflemen directed the offending tanker to the country's southern coasts and handed it over to judicial authorities.

events.title_en: Overcoming emergency aid equipment crisis with support of Islamic Consultative Assembly
events.summary_en: Overcoming emergency aid equipment crisis with support of Islamic Consultative Assembly. Head of the Red Crescent Society said: Strengthening logistics and providing modern emergency equipment with the backing of representatives played a determining role in the success of rescue operations, especially in the recent war. In the recent war, there was no shortage in providing facilities; this was while at one point during the same 12-day war, the warehouses of five provinces were completely emptied. With parliament's support, modern equipment including life-finding devices was provided and this helped to improve the performance of rescue operations.
